title: Simulator source metadata v1
description: The P01 /v1/meta envelope, as consumed by P02 and by the P09 independent oracle. Field names mirror simulator.api.schemas.MetaOut. These are SIMULATOR semantics: run_id, generation, snapshot_seq and source_seq do not exist in a real MT5 Manager SDK and no test may treat their presence as evidence about one.

run_id.description: Active run, or null when no run has been created.

generation.description: Incremented by a reset. A new generation is a new source incarnation and must never be merged with the previous one.

seed.description: Deterministic generation seed. Replay is guaranteed only within one generator version.

spec_hash.description: Digest of the scenario specification that produced this run.

status.description: Run lifecycle state. READ_ONLY_REPAIR_REQUIRED means projections disagree with the event log and a human must decide, so readiness is false.

snapshot_seq.description: Upper bound over the source event log. NOT a Deal count and NOT a Deal id.

virtual_time.description: Current virtual clock reading, ISO-8601 UTC.

capabilities.description: What this source can and cannot prove. A consumer must read this instead of assuming a capability exists.
